ambiguity_flags.note: Observed in two canonical_doc_extracts: README_v1.md line 13 ('Layer-2 is the data ingestion and truth store') and README_LAYER2.md line 31 (same phrase). 'truth store' conflates Layer-2 component identity with Snapshot Truth semantics and the observations persistence layer. Term was previously rejected per project governance record (MEMORY.md: 'Rejected terminology: truth_store (conflates LAYER_2/SNAPSHOT_TRUTH/OBSERVATIONS)'). Not present in the canonical term table, but conflicts with Category A (Snapshot boundary) governance-sensitive rules — weakening the semantic boundary between what Layer-2 is as a component and what Snapshot Truth is as a governed concept. This is pre-existing drift in canonical documents, not introduced by claims c1–c5. Downstream documentation update steps working on these documents should normalize the phrase.
